_comment: HTML post plan. 'head_meta' works only on a FULL document (one with a <head>); an HTML fragment has nowhere to put it, so those values go in the report for the site template or post registry to consume. Anchors are the heading's visible text — no '## ' prefix. Blocks are HTML.
